name: Template: Project Delivery
description: Track projects from planning through retrospective. Each swimlane represents an active project.

swimlanes.name: Website Relaunch
swimlanes.notes: Brand refresh + CMS migration. Go-live target: 2026-05-01. Owner: Head of Marketing.

swimlanes.name: ERP Migration
swimlanes.notes: SAP → NetSuite migration. 6-month project. Cutover target: 2026-09-01. High risk.

swimlanes.name: Mobile App Launch
swimlanes.notes: iOS and Android launch. App Store review target: 2026-04-15.

swimlanes.name: Security Audit
swimlanes.notes: Annual pen test + SOC 2 Type II evidence collection. Vendor: CrowdStrike.

swimlanes.name: Data Center Move
swimlanes.notes: Relocate from legacy co-lo to AWS. Target: zero-downtime migration. Q3 2026.

cards.title: Define brand refresh scope and deliverables
cards.description:
Align stakeholders on what the brand refresh covers:

- New logo and colour palette ✓
- Updated typography
- Revised tone of voice guide
- Photography / illustration style

Out of scope: product UI changes (separate project).

comments.body: Scope doc drafted. Waiting on CEO calendar for sign-off meeting.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Stakeholder sign-off on new wireframes
cards.description:
Design agency delivered 12 wireframe screens for review. Feedback due by 2026-03-12 (OVERDUE).

Key reviewers: CMO, Head of Product, Head of Engineering.

checklist.text: Consolidate feedback and send to agency

comments.body: CMO approved with minor changes. Engineering review still pending.
comments.author: demo1

comments.body: BLOCKED: Head of Engineering on leave until Monday.
comments.author: demo2

cards.title: Content migration: 150 pages to new CMS
cards.description:
Migrate all 150 public-facing pages from the legacy CMS (Drupal 7) to the new CMS (Contentful).

Migration plan:
1. Export Drupal content as JSON
2. Transform and import via Contentful API
3. QA each page in staging
4. Redirect legacy URLs

comments.body: 50 priority pages migrated. On track for full migration.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: SEO audit of new site before go-live
cards.description:
Run a full SEO audit before launch:

- Verify all canonical URLs
- Check meta titles and descriptions
- Validate sitemap.xml
- Confirm no broken internal links
- Check Core Web Vitals (LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1)

checklist.text: Core Web Vitals check via PageSpeed Insights

comments.body: 8 broken links found. Fixing before milestone review.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Go-live: DNS cutover and legacy redirects
cards.description:
Final go-live steps:

1. Update DNS to point to new infrastructure
2. Verify SSL certificate auto-renews
3. Confirm all legacy URLs redirect (301) correctly
4. Monitor error rate for 24h post-launch

checklist.text: Update DNS TTL to 60s (24h before cutover)

comments.body: TTL reduced. Cutover scheduled for Saturday 2am PT.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Cutover weekend plan and rollback procedure
cards.description:
Document the cutover plan for the 2026-09-01 weekend:

- Friday EOD: freeze SAP transactions
- Saturday: final data migration run
- Sunday: validation and smoke tests
- Monday 08:00: go-live on NetSuite

Rollback: revert to SAP if critical issues found before 10:00 Monday.

checklist.text: Get CFO sign-off on cutover plan
Brief all team leads on weekend plan

cards.title: Vendor selection complete: NetSuite chosen
cards.description:
After a 6-week RFP process, NetSuite was selected over Oracle Fusion.

Decision factors:
- Total cost of ownership 20% lower
- Faster implementation timeline
- Better mid-market fit

SOW signed 2026-02-15.

comments.body: SOW signed. Implementation partner onboarding next week.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Data mapping: legacy SAP schema → NetSuite
cards.description:
Map all 340 SAP data objects to their NetSuite equivalents.

## Status

- Finance module: 85/120 objects mapped ✓
- HR module: 30/90 objects mapped
- Inventory module: 0/130 objects mapped — not started

Blocked on HR: data privacy review required.

comments.body: OVERDUE: HR privacy review delayed by legal. Escalated.
comments.author: demo1

comments.body: Legal cleared HR review. Resuming HR mapping.
comments.author: demo2

cards.title: Parallel run: both systems live simultaneously
cards.description:
Run SAP and NetSuite simultaneously for 30 days to validate:

- All transactions reconcile between systems
- Month-end close works in NetSuite
- Reports match within 0.1% tolerance

Start date: 2026-07-01.

cards.title: User acceptance testing (UAT) — Finance team
cards.description:
Finance team UAT covering 45 test scenarios:

- Invoice creation and approval workflow
- Month-end close process
- Multi-currency transactions
- Expense report submission

checklist.text: Run UAT with Finance team (5 days)

cards.title: Marketing launch plan sign-off
cards.description:
Marketing has prepared the launch plan:

- Press release to 12 tech publications
- Product Hunt launch on GA day
- Email campaign to existing web users (8,000)
- Social media content calendar (2 weeks)

Needs CEO and CMO sign-off.

checklist.text: Embargo dates confirmed with press contacts

comments.body: Both signed off. Press embargoes being coordinated.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Beta TestFlight cohort (200 users)
cards.description:
Recruit 200 beta testers via TestFlight for a 2-week closed beta.

Focus areas:
- Drag-and-drop on iOS
- Push notification reliability
- Offline sync behaviour

NPS target: ≥ 45.

checklist.text: Collect NPS survey at end of beta

comments.body: 200 testers active. Crash rate at 0.3% — need to get below 0.1%.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: App Store metadata and screenshots
cards.description:
Prepare App Store and Google Play listing assets:

- App name, subtitle, description (all locales)
- 10 screenshots per device size
- App preview video (30s)
- Privacy policy URL

comments.body: iPhone screenshots done. iPad and video still needed.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Crash rate: must be below 0.1% before GA
cards.description:
Current crash rate: 0.3% (TestFlight). Target: < 0.1%.

Top crashes from Sentry:
1. NullPointerException in DragDropController (Android) — 60%
2. IndexOutOfBoundsException in SwimlaneAdapter — 25%
3. Network timeout not handled on reconnect — 15%

comments.body: NPE fixed. Crash rate dropped to 0.15%. Two more to go.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Post-launch retrospective
cards.description:
30-min retro with the mobile team one week post-launch.

Agenda:
- What went well
- What slowed us down
- One thing to change for the next launch

Document outcomes in Confluence.

comments.body: Retro done. Key outcome: start App Store asset prep 4 weeks earlier next time.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Pen test scope approved by CrowdStrike
cards.description:
Scope agreed with CrowdStrike:

- External web application (production)
- API endpoints
- Authentication and authorisation flows
- WebSocket layer

Out of scope: internal infrastructure, employee workstations.

checklist.text: Scope document signed by both parties

comments.body: Pen test started on schedule.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: CrowdStrike engagement: active pen testing
cards.description:
Active pen test running 2026-03-17 to 2026-03-21.

Daily check-ins with CrowdStrike lead. Monitor production logs for anomalies during test window.

All findings will be reported in the final report.

comments.body: Day 3: 2 medium findings flagged so far. No criticals.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Remediate 3 HIGH severity findings
cards.description:
CrowdStrike report delivered. 3 HIGH findings to remediate:

1. **Insecure Direct Object Reference** on `/api/cards/{id}/` — no ownership check
2. **Missing rate limiting** on password reset endpoint
3. **Verbose error messages** leaking stack traces in 500 responses

All 3 must be remediated before SOC 2 evidence collection.

checklist.text: Fix IDOR: add board membership check on card endpoint
Add rate limiting to password reset
Retest with CrowdStrike to confirm fixes

comments.body: IDOR fix deployed. Rate limiting and stack traces in progress.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: SOC 2 evidence collection — Q1 2026
cards.description:
Collect evidence for the following SOC 2 Type II controls:

- CC6.1: Logical access controls
- CC7.2: Security incident procedures
- CC8.1: Change management
- A1.1: Availability commitments

Evidence period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31.

checklist.text: CC8.1: export MR audit trail from GitLab
A1.1: export uptime data from PagerDuty

cards.title: Audit report delivered to leadership
cards.description:
CrowdStrike delivered the final pen test report. All 3 HIGH findings confirmed remediated.

Report summary shared with CEO, CTO, and Board of Directors.

Next audit: Q1 2027.

comments.body: Report filed. No open findings. Clean bill of health.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Network topology design for AWS VPC
cards.description:
Design the AWS VPC network topology:

- 3 AZs for high availability
- Private subnets for app servers and RDS
- Public subnets for load balancers only
- VPN gateway for on-prem connectivity during migration

Review with network team before provisioning.

comments.body: Architecture diagram ready for review.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Live migration weekend: zero-downtime cutover
cards.description:
Zero-downtime cutover plan:

1. Enable active-active mode (traffic to both co-lo and AWS)
2. Drain co-lo gradually (10% → 50% → 100% AWS)
3. Monitor error rate at each step — abort if > 0.5%
4. Decommission co-lo load balancer after 48h stability

Migration weekend: 2026-08-15.

checklist.text: All stakeholders notified of migration weekend
On-call rota confirmed for migration weekend

cards.title: Hardware decommission: racks 14–22
cards.description:
After migration, decommission racks 14–22 in the legacy co-lo:

- Wipe all disks (DoD 5220.22-M standard)
- Return leased hardware to vendor
- Cancel co-lo contract (30-day notice required)

Estimated savings: $8,400/month.

checklist.text: Confirm all services off legacy hardware

cards.title: Application dependency mapping
cards.description:
Map all 38 applications and their dependencies before migration:

- Which apps talk to each other?
- Which apps have hard-coded IP addresses (need updating)?
- Which apps have co-lo-specific config?

Use network traffic analysis + manual interviews with app owners.

checklist.text: Interview app owners for 20 critical apps

comments.body: OVERDUE: 3 app owners unavailable. Blocked on Finance apps.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Failover test: production traffic to DR site
cards.description:
Simulate a primary site failure and verify that:

1. Traffic fails over to the AWS DR site within 60 seconds
2. All data is consistent (RDS read replica is current)
3. Recovery time objective (RTO) < 5 minutes is met

Schedule maintenance window: Sunday 02:00–04:00 PT.

checklist.text: Run failover test in maintenance window

comments.body: DR environment ready. Test scheduled for Sunday.
comments.author: demo1
